differentiator: It hands Claude real frames and a timestamped transcript from any video, so Claude answers from what it actually saw at a given moment, not the title.

concepts.name: GIVE IT EYES (chosen)
concepts.world: A machine-vision green terminal world. We open inside a Claude session that is blind to a video, then watch the skill give it sight: one command, a contact-sheet of extracted frames (near-dupes greyed out), the three-stage pipeline running, and finally Claude answering a question about a specific second from what it SAW.
concepts.shows: A blind agent -> the install -> a frame mosaic assembling -> captions/frames/audio panes -> the grounded answer landing -> the star receipt -> a bright 'now it watches' button.
concepts.money_shot: Scene 5: the grounded answer reveals in the app window ('at 0:30 he opens the terminal / claude read the frame, not the title') with a scale-punch.
concepts.world_color: violet AI-perception console (the color of a model seeing), a palette no recent tribute has touched
concepts.why_creator_reposts: It shows his engineering, not just his star chart -- the frame dedup and captions-first economy are on screen, and the payoff is his tool doing something models can't do alone.
concepts.why_stranger_stops: Cold friction hook ('a plain agent sees the title, not one frame') is a problem every agent builder feels, and the frame mosaic is a visual no other tribute this month has used.

concepts.name: THE CONTACT SHEET
concepts.world: Pure montage: the whole video is a photographer's contact sheet, 30 seconds of frames, and a marker circles the one frame that answers the question.
concepts.shows: A grid of frames filling the screen, dupes fading, one frame lighting up as the answer.
concepts.money_shot: The single frame igniting out of the grid.
concepts.why_creator_reposts: Beautiful, but it under-shows the pipeline and the install-anywhere reach.
concepts.why_stranger_stops: Gorgeous but risks reading as abstract art, not a tool. Folded its best beat (the mosaic) into the chosen concept as scene 3.

concepts.name: THE UNMUTE
concepts.world: Split of what an agent 'hears' (a thin transcript) vs what it now 'sees' (frames + transcript), a before/after.
concepts.shows: Left: title only. Right: frames streaming in.
concepts.money_shot: The right pane flooding with frames.
concepts.why_creator_reposts: Clear, but before/after + split is exactly the 07-06 shape (split_compare) and is banned this run.
concepts.why_stranger_stops: Good tension, but structurally a repeat. Rejected on the concept gate grounds.

wow_bets: The frame mosaic assembling with 'dup' tiles greying out -- the dedup made visible.
The grounded answer as the money shot (elegant_output), scale-punched on the money-cut.
A violet AI-perception world, a palette no recent tribute has touched.
color_script: Deep slate-violet canvas (luma ~49) holds most beats; brightness lives in two planned beats -- the frame mosaic (scene 3, bright tiles) and the full-bleed violet FLASH button (scene 7). >= 2 brightness beats by design; the frame passes the brightness gate without leaning on the grade. Accent violet hue ~266 sits >= 60 off both recent palettes (07-05 warm 9, 07-06 cool 200) and is a different world from the 06-23 green terminal.
light_plan: s1 screen_capture: bright accent-ink first line in the window. s2 terminal: bright typed command on dark frame. s3 montage: 12 bright tiles (the light source). s4 panes: bright status names + state dots. s5 money screen_capture: the answer in bright ink, accent-ink lead line. s6 big_number: bright count-up numeral. s7 flash: full violet field, the brightest beat. Every scene owns a bright element >= hero scale.
illustrates_plan: Each scene's copy is enacted by its picture: friction shown as a blind window; the command shown typed; frames shown as a real mosaic with dedup; the pipeline shown as running panes; the answer shown grounded in a seen frame; growth shown as a climbing number; the thesis shown as a bright button. No decorative scenes.
cutting_plan: Hard cuts by default (no dissolve). The one reserved transition effect (push) fires on the money-shot cut (into scene 5). Foley transient (tapestop_drop) lands only on the money beat. Motion carries THROUGH cuts (the mosaic is already assembling when scene 3 enters; the count is already climbing when scene 6 enters).
